conclusion_reason: Section 34(1) gives the data subject the right to have use suspended while the controller is verifying under a section 36 request, and section 34 paragraph 2 allows a complaint to the expert committee if the controller does not comply, exactly as the answer concludes.

problems.quote: บันทึกทุกคำขอ/การปฏิเสธลงในรายการ (ROPA) ตาม ม.๓๙(๗) เพราะเป็นหน้าที่ตรงและมีโทษตาม ม.๘๒
problems.why: Section 39(7) requires recording only refusals of requests or objections under sections 30 para 3, 31 para 3, 32 para 3 and 36 para 1, not every request, and it does not list refusal of a section 34 suspension request.
